run_pregenerate_training_data: run the script to pregenerate BERT masked LM and next sentence prediction training data from a text corpus
create_DocumentDatabase: create a DocumentDatabase instance to store and sample documents with optional memory reduction via disk-backed shelve
create_masked_lm_predictions: create masked LM predictions by selecting tokens to mask using whole-word or per-WordPiece masking strategies
create_instances_from_document: create training instances from a document by sampling sentence pairs for masked LM and next sentence prediction tasks
create_training_file: create a training file containing JSON-encoded BERT training instances for a given epoch
